all_found.desc: [BUG] The failures=N pattern matches Python unittest's standard PASSING summary 'OK (expected failures=1)' / 'OK (skipped=1, expected failures=1)', which no neutralizer covers. Verified against base: base reads it as passing (exit 0), head as failing (exit 1) — honest passing unittest evidence is rejected by the gates.

[ADVISORY] The bare-fail pattern excludes a 'fail' preceded by '-' or '.', so tokens like 'build-fail', 'unit-tests-fail', 'result.fail' no longer count; the base (?i)\bFAIL\b counted them. Narrow fail-open regression when no other failure signal is present.
